new_source_directions: Use NVIDIA's official investor-relations fiscal 2027 first-quarter financial-results release or its official results landing page available on or before 2026-07-12, distinct from the conference-call transcript and SEC annual or quarterly reports.

Follow only the NVIDIA-owned landing page to the full official release, and require explicit SK hynix plus HBM attribution and a machine-readable forward period or commitment term; snippets and third-party summaries remain discovery-only.

suggested_queries.literal_query: SK hynix NVIDIA fiscal 2027 first quarter financial results HBM supplier commitments
suggested_queries.rationale: The 32 executed queries covered NVIDIA's GTC material, FY2026 annual report, Form 10-Q, and May 2026 earnings-call transcript or prepared remarks, but not NVIDIA's separate fiscal 2027 first-quarter official financial-results release or its investor-relations landing page. Search that distinct customer-issued document class only for explicit joint attribution to SK hynix and HBM plus a numeric forward period, quantity, non-cancellable commitment, advance payment, or capacity agreement; generic NVIDIA demand, aggregate supply commitments, or supplier-unnamed HBM commentary does not resolve DURABLE_VISIBILITY.

unresolved_research_notes: The official results release may discuss data-center demand or supply commitments only in aggregate and may not name SK hynix. If both SK hynix and HBM are not explicit with a forward numeric term, keep DURABLE_VISIBILITY unresolved.
No new issuer-official document class was identified for FORWARD_GUIDANCE or SEGMENT_CONTRIBUTION after reviewing all 32 prior queries, so no synonym-only query was proposed for those roles.
